methods.warmups: Task 6 observations marked warmup=true are excluded from all measured statistics.
methods.descriptiveStatistics: Mean, median, sample standard deviation (n-1), minimum, maximum, and nearest-rank P95/P99 are computed over individual measured observations.
methods.latencyAndPrecisionConfidenceIntervals: 95% percentile bootstrap intervals for means, resampling 30 repetition-level block means with replacement; 10,000 resamples by default and deterministic metric-specific seeds.
methods.proportionConfidenceIntervals: 95% Wilson score intervals over the request, returned-document, or revocation-event units. These nominal intervals assume independent Bernoulli units; repeated units within a repetition may be correlated. Cluster-level any-exposure/any-failure and all-events-handled Wilson intervals are included as a separate conservative view.
methods.significance: No hypothesis tests or statistical significance claims are made.

groundTruth.relevanceRule: A document is relevant exactly when its generated topic ID matches the query topic ID; permissions are not consulted.
